node.statement: At level n, matrix multiplication and I_A^dagger=I_A give v_n(X)v_n(Y)-v_n(XY)=XY tensor (I_A^2-I_A) and v_n(X^*)=v_n(X)^dagger, while v_n(I_n)=I_n tensor I_A is the designated target unit. The approximate-unit axioms give ||I_A^2-I_A||<=epsilon||I_A|| and 1-epsilon<=||I_A||<=1+epsilon. Applying the scalar cross-norm identity from node 1.1 and ||XY||<=||X||||Y|| yields a product defect at most epsilon(1+epsilon)||X||||Y||<=2epsilon||X||||Y||.
